Extend Claude Code Limits

TokenTrim is a free, local toolkit that helps extend Claude Code usage limits by optimizing tool output and file reading. By using TokenTrim, developers can make their Claude Code limits last roughly 4x longer.

What you get

Free version available, Pro lifetime license for $49, Pro monthly subscription for $9

Why tokentrim

TokenTrim is designed for developers and CTOs at 10-200 person US software companies who frequently hit Claude Code limits. It provides a dashboard to track token spend per session, helping teams optimize their Claude Code usage.

FAQ

Is TokenTrim affiliated with Anthropic? No, TokenTrim is not affiliated with Anthropic.

What is the cost of TokenTrim Pro? TokenTrim Pro is available for a lifetime license of $49 or a monthly subscription of $9.

Next step: Download TokenTrim for free and start extending your Claude Code limits today.
